cross_product_finding: This is the ONE page in the 13-page batch whose code sample is not byte-identical to its Capella twin (cloud/eventing/eventing-handler-fasterToLocalString.md; a plain-text diff of the two .md files shows every other difference is limited to front matter/editUrl/xref). Worth surfacing at reconciliation as support for treating eventing-debugging-and-diagnosability.md as a structural Server-only feature difference rather than an incidental content gap.
